subject: Discovery recap — prioritized pain, goals, MAP timetable and decision owners
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@novata.com>, Ava Singh <ava@novata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — prioritized pain, goals & next steps

Thanks again for taking time today — quick recap so we all have the same view and a proposed mutual action plan (attached). Highlights below; please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points (what we heard)
- Latency spikes for chat & summarization flows in EU region (95th pct > 600ms) causing poor UX.
- High inference spend on mixed workloads (batch + interactive) with unclear caching/batching setup.
- Inconsistent outputs for multi-turn support scenarios (model hallucination on system prompts).
- Regulatory constraint: certain PII flows must remain in region and require audit logs + KMS control.

Stated goals
- Get interactive latency down to <= 150–200ms P95 for customer-facing chat in US/EU.
- Reduce per-100k-token inference cost by ~35–45% vs current baseline.
- Pilot private deployment for regulated flows with KMS and audit logs.

Immediate next steps / owner suggestions (proposed MAP)
1) Technical deep-dive + log handoff — target: Jun 16 — owner: Ben Carter (redwood).
2) Pilot scope finalization (endpoints, datasets, security requirements) — target: Jun 23 — owner: Samir (Novata) + Priya (coord).
3) Procurement & pricing review (PO terms, timeline) — target: Jun 30 — owner: Jordan Proc (Novata).
4) Pilot kick (dedicated capacity or private preview) — target: Jul 12 — owner: Ben (tech), Lauren (exec sponsor).

Attachments: Novata_MAP_Q2-2026.xlsx (mutual action plan spreadsheet, milestones/owners), Novata_SOC2_summary.pdf (SOC 2 scope summary).
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Questions for Novata
- Can you confirm who on your side will own procurement and security reviews (we heard Jordan for procurement; please confirm).
- Is the EU latency problem isolated to a single region or cross-region? Helpful if you can share sample request IDs before the technical deep-dive.

Proposed follow-ups
- Technical deep-dive (60m) — Jun 16 (Ben + Priya + Samir + Ava)
- Procurement sync (30m) — Jun 24

Thanks — I’ll drop the MAP and a short one-pager into HubSpot. If this looks right, please reply with any edits to the owners/dates and we’ll lock it in.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
[attachment: Novata_MAP_Q2-2026.xlsx (spreadsheet)] [attachment: Novata_SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Samir Khan <samir@novata.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Singh <ava@novata.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — prioritized pain, goals & next steps

Thanks Priya — this is a great recap. Quick clarifications from our side: 
- Procurement: please loop in Jordan Proc (jordan.proc@novata.com) — he’ll own PO timing and standard terms.
- Security: our InfoSec will need the SOC 2 artifact plus a short data retention / deletion policy for pilot data. Can you confirm whether Redwood can support region-bound storage + KMS integration?
- Timeline: Jun 16 deep-dive works. For procurement, our internal approval window is typically 2–3 weeks after final pricing.

Also, for the latency samples — I’ll pull 3 example request IDs and share them before Friday.

Samir
Director of Product, Novata
samir@novata.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@novata.com>, Ava Singh <ava@novata.com>, Jordan Proc <jordan.proc@novata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — prioritized pain, goals & next steps

Appreciate the quick turn, Samir — looping Jordan in now. Answers below and an updated MAP attached with explicit owners/dates: 

Security + compliance
- We can support region-bound inference and storage for pilot flows (EU-only enforcement) and integrate with customer KMS for key management. Ben will cover audit log retention and retention policy in the tech deep-dive.
- Attached: Novata_SOC2_summary.pdf (scope + controls) and a short data-retention note.

Pricing & procurement
- We’ll provide a tailored pricing sheet that shows (a) hosted API estimate, (b) dedicated GPU pilot estimate, and (c) private deployment one-time fees. Expect that sheet by Friday (Jun 12).

Updated MAP (high level milestones & dates)
- Jun 12: Pricing & pilot SOW draft — owner: Priya
- Jun 16: Tech deep-dive + log handoff — owner: Ben
- Jun 23: Pilot scope sign-off & security checklist closed — owners: Samir + Priya
- Jun 30: Procurement sign-off window begins (target PO) — owner: Jordan
- Jul 12: Pilot start (30–60 day pilot) — owner: Ben

Attachments: Novata_MAP_Q2-2026.xlsx (updated), Novata_SOC2_summary.pdf
DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/abc123
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Jordan — can you confirm your typical PO timeline and whether Novata needs net-60 payment terms? If so we’ll surface that to our legal early to avoid delays.

Samir/Ava — if you can share the three sample request IDs that show the latency spikes that would be ideal before the deep-dive. Ben will prepare an agenda focused on logs, model-config, and batching behavior.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
[attachment: Novata_MAP_Q2-2026.xlsx (spreadsheet)] [attachment: Novata_SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — prioritized pain, goals & next steps (internal)

Priya / Lauren — internal note before we run the deep-dive: 
- Confirmed: we can run an EU-region pilot with customer KMS and audit logs. We’ll need a short data-sampling agreement for troubleshooting (covering sample IDs + redaction).
- Feasibility: achieving ~150–200ms P95 for interactive at small scale is realistic with dedicated capacity + prefix caching; we’ll validate during the Jun 16 deep-dive.
- Commercial note: 30–60 day dedicated pilot is doable. If Novata requires net-60 and a trial discount, we should flag for an exec exception from Lauren for anything >15% discount.

I’ll prepare a short slide (tech checklist + logs we need) and share before the deep-dive.

– Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
